l3.title: Millimeter World Unit Model
evidence: om9-core/src/geometry.rs:37-63 enum Unit {Millimeter, Centimeter, Meter, Inch, Foot, Micrometer}; Unit::factor; Unit::length_to_mm rejects a non-finite RESULT
om9-core/src/model.rs:183 Document::new sets page_unit = Unit::Millimeter; Document.page_unit is a required serde field (no default)
om9-core/src/history.rs:124-126 Recipe::validate rejects environment.length_unit != Millimeter ('canonical recipe lengths')
om9-core/src/geometry.rs:227 NurbsCurve::convert_lengths validates all conversions before mutating
om9-app/src/session.rs:318-330 CMD 'x,y[,z]' text converts each coordinate with s.unit.length_to_mm
TEST om9-core/tests/model_admission.rs:270 unit_conversion_changes_lengths_without_scaling_dimensionless_basis
TEST om9-app/tests/command_sessions.rs:60 numeric_cmd_points_use_page_units_and_captured_cplane_exactly_once
gaps: No typed canonical length: lengths are raw f64; there is no LengthMm::try_new(f64) -> Result<LengthMm, UnitError>. NaN input is only rejected by accident (NaN * factor is non-finite).
No Unit::parse(token) and no typed UnsupportedUnit error for an unknown unit token.
'2.5 mm serializes and reloads exactly' is untested, and arbitrary computed lengths do NOT reload exactly (see OM9-L3-01-08-006 root cause).

l3.title: Angle Conversion And Degrees
evidence: Only ad-hoc radians exist: om9-scene/src/workspace.rs:115 35f64.to_radians() for the perspective camera; om9-core/src/history.rs:20 Tolerance.angular_rad; om9-core/src/geometry.rs:304 Circle.angle_domain (radians)
om9-core/src/request.rs:17-22 Dimension::Angle exists but no unit convention (degrees vs radians) is defined for its value
gaps: No AngleDeg / AngleRad types, no degree<->radian conversion owner, no bound for very large angles, no rejection of radians mislabeled as degrees.

l3.title: Document Absolute Relative Tolerances
evidence: om9-core/src/history.rs:14-31 struct Tolerance {absolute_mm, relative, angular_rad}; validate() requires finite, >= 0 and absolute_mm != 0
om9-core/src/history.rs:33-43 ReplayEnvironment.tolerance (per recipe, not per document)
om9-core/src/retained.rs:43-53 NativeUnits.{absolute_tolerance, relative_tolerance, angular_tolerance_radians} keep imported SOURCE-space tolerances only
TEST om9-core/tests/history_replay.rs:49-55 recipes carry Tolerance {absolute_mm: 0.001, relative: 1e-6}
gaps: No per-document tolerance field on Document (model.rs:129-168), no accessor, no undoable mutation.
No Tolerance::try_new constructor; no check that a feature size at or below the absolute tolerance is refused.
No pass-through from the document to the kernel/replay environment.
No archive legacy guard for a new 'tolerance' key (om9-archive/src/json_admission.rs:50-55).
l3.m00: NEEDS_USER_M00_DECISION for two sub-items: (a) persisting Document.tolerance adds a key to the .om9 metadata = archive format decision; (b) kernel pass-through targets OCCT (not approved and OM9-L2-01-05 absent). The in-memory type, constructor, feature check, mutation and accessor need no decision and are implemented first.

l3.title: Builder Parameter Range Validation
evidence: om9-core/src/request.rs:65-72 OptionDomain::Number {dimension, min, min_inclusive, max}
om9-core/src/request.rs:386-391 finite, min/max and exclusive-min checks
TEST om9-core/tests/source_binding.rs:160 (NaN and exclusive minimum)

gaps: ROOT CAUSE of the known Line-save failure: the workspace pins serde_json =1.0.150 with default features only (standalone/Cargo.toml:13; target/*/.fingerprint/serde_json-*: features [default, std]). Without 'float_roundtrip' the parser is best-effort: a scratch probe with the same pinned crate gave 13.416407864998739 (hypot(12,6), the domain end of the Line 0,0,0 -> 12,6,0) -> '13.416407864998739' -> 13.41640786499874, and 15461 of 199999 sampled f64 values did not round-trip. atomic_file.rs:75 then fails 'archive encoding verification'. Point 1,2,3 saves because its values are exact integers.
No round-trip test for Length/Angle parameter values or for an arbitrary computed length.
Bare Number for a dimensioned parameter is not refused (same gap as L3-004).
l3.m00: No M00 decision: the fix changes only how the reader parses floats; the writer (shortest round-trip text) and therefore the .om9 bytes and schema are unchanged, and no crate version or Cargo.lock entry changes. GUARD: if any existing golden byte/fingerprint test changes after the feature flag, the coder stops and asks (archive format / Reproducible are not approved).
l3.reuse: Manifest feature fix (one line) + EXTEND request.rs; tests in om9-core and om9-archive

line_save_bug.verdict: Not an OM9-L2-01-02 transaction or OM9-L2-01-03 snapshot defect. Owner of the codec is OM9-L2-01-12 (native project codec); the defect is the serde_json parser configuration it relies on. Because OM9-L3-01-08-006 ('serializes and reloads exactly') and OM9-L3-01-03-012 (restore reproduces geometry) both require exact f64 round-trips, the one-line fix is scheduled as the FIRST item of the OM9-L2-01-08 loop. No archive logic changes.
line_save_bug.red_test: om9-archive/tests/float_roundtrip.rs: Archive::save of a Document holding Curve::Line {start [0,0,0], end [12,6,0], domain [0, 12f64.hypot(6.)]} returns Err(Invalid("archive encoding verification")) before the fix and Ok after; reopened entity equals the saved one bit-for-bit
